summary: Guangzhou suits food-led urban travel built around Lingnan street life, early-to-late dining culture, riverside evenings, and practical district-based routing.
transport_notes: Metro plus short walks works well for central Guangzhou, especially when plans stay within one historic or riverside zone per half day.
Old-city areas are best paired with nearby food streets instead of cross-city landmark hopping.
Evening plans work best around the Pearl River, Tianhe nightlife pockets, or classic old-neighborhood dining zones.

budget_notes.low: Focus on street food, old-city walks, and metro-friendly neighborhoods with dense eating options.
budget_notes.medium: Combine one heritage district, one signature food zone, and one softer riverside or market-area stop each day.
budget_notes.high: Add more refined Cantonese dining, slower riverside pacing, and comfort-oriented transitions between districts.

trip_type_notes.student: Student plans in Guangzhou should emphasize affordable local eats, lively neighborhoods, and easy transit execution.
trip_type_notes.solo: Solo plans should feel grounded in local street rhythm, market life, and flexible neighborhood wandering.
trip_type_notes.couple: Couple plans should balance Lingnan heritage, atmospheric dining, and soft riverfront evening scenes.
trip_type_notes.family: Family plans should avoid excessive transfers and favor calmer heritage streets, parks, and easy dining stops.

pois.name: Yongqingfang
pois.description: A Lingnan-style old district with arcade buildings, walkable lanes, and an accessible introduction to old Guangzhou.

pois.name: Shamian Island
pois.description: A calmer walking area known for leafy streets, heritage facades, and gentler pacing.

pois.name: Beijing Road
pois.description: A practical city-core stop mixing shopping, visible history layers, and easy food access.

pois.name: Canton Tower Riverfront Edge
pois.description: A modern riverside setting suited to evening light, skyline views, and polished city atmosphere.

pois.name: Chen Clan Ancestral Hall Area
pois.description: A strong heritage anchor for plans that want architecture, craft detail, and a recognizable Lingnan culture stop.

pois.name: Pearl River Evening Walk
pois.description: A smooth evening add-on where skyline lights and river air create a softer urban finish.

food_areas.name: Xihua Road Food Stretch
food_areas.note: Best for affordable neighborhood food with a strong everyday Guangzhou feel.

food_areas.name: Yongqingfang and Liwan Food Pockets
food_areas.note: Best when paired with old-city walking and slower heritage-oriented pacing.

food_areas.name: Pearl River Dining Zone
food_areas.note: Best for more polished evening meals and a softer skyline-led mood.
